raw_transcript:
Start of a new month, beginning the guard-pulling unit with coach DC.
Covered three guard-pull/takedown entries plus sweep chains from the leg
grab and a triangle setup off the biceps/bar step. One roll during open mat.

Techniques:
- Arm drag to single leg (come around to back, grab leg)
- Seated guard pull with scissor feet, pull back from there
- De La Riva pull keeping the sleeve grip (not grabbing the leg)
- Outside-leg sweep off the leg grab (forward/back drag, over to shoulder)
- On their stand, re-drag down; on the second stand, swivel to opposite side
- Biceps/bar step entry: foot off hip onto biceps, other foot into hip, drag down, slide up and bite the shoulder to set up the triangle

Rolls:
- One open-mat roll
